scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved directly by sketched normal equations and a sharp two-dimensional spectral inequality. Finite reproducibility experiments are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. The source preprint supplies the motivating weaker sufficient condition; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic exact-arithmetic result assuming an exact sketched least-squares minimizer, incumbent in the same affine trial space, and a squared-norm embedding on the full residual span. It does not cover approximate inner solves, changing quadratic weights, probabilistic sketch success rates, or finite precision. At zero observed decrease the true residuals coincide; at a zero sketched optimum the true residual is zero. An equivalent older formulation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp norm-distortion descent envelope for exact sketched least-squares minimizers
